entities.name: invoices

source_columns: Real invoices id: auto-increment int (2017_03_07_173109 $table->increments('id')). DESIGN: retyped to uuid PK to match Nexus convention (legacy carried its own id + invoice_number, so no control_number FK).
invoices.invoice_number string unique (2017_03_07_173109 $table->string('invoice_number')->unique()).

invoices.customer_id unsigned int FK->customers (2017_03_07_173109; FK added 2018_08_29_123922 references('id')->on('customers')). Cross-domain → accounts (10) [legacy 'customers']; retyped to uuid. No in-file rel.

invoices.location_id unsigned int FK->locations (2017_03_07_173109; FK added 2018_08_29_123922 references('id')->on('locations')). Cross-domain → facilities (01) [legacy 'locations']; retyped to uuid. No in-file rel.
invoices.is_locked bool default 0 (2017_03_21_113437 boolean('is_locked')->default(0)).
invoices.is_closed bool default false (2017_04_18_182923 boolean('is_closed')->default(false)).
invoices.discount double (2017_04_05_162400 $table->double('discount')). DESIGN: legacy double → numeric (house convention).
invoices.locked_date nullable timestamp (2018_01_22_181639 timestamp('locked_date')->nullable()->default(null)).
invoices.closed_date nullable timestamp (2018_01_22_181639 timestamp('closed_date')->nullable()->default(null)).

entities.proposal_reason: Real PhytoVerify finance source — invoices header table (PhytoverifyOG 2017_03_07_173109_create_invoices_table.php + locked/closed/discount/date amendments). Bridges finance↔sales via customer_id → accounts (10) [legacy 'customers']; location_id → facilities (01) [legacy 'locations'] is cross-file so no in-file rel is drawn (same convention as finance_activities.product_id). DESIGN: int ids retyped to uuid.

entities.name: invoice_lines

source_columns: Real invoice_lines id: auto-increment int (2017_03_07_173118 $table->increments('id')). DESIGN: retyped to uuid PK.
invoice_lines.invoice_id unsigned int FK->invoices (2017_03_07_173118; FK added 2018_08_29_123210 references('id')->on('invoices')). In-file rel → invoices (cascade).
invoice_lines.package_id unsigned int FK->packages (2017_03_07_173118; FK added 2018_08_29_123210 references('id')->on('packages')). Cross-domain → packages (05); retyped to uuid. No in-file rel.
invoice_lines.quantity int (2017_03_07_173118 $table->integer('quantity')).
invoice_lines.unit_cost float(5,2) (2017_03_07_173118 $table->float('unit_cost',5,2)). DESIGN: retyped float→numeric(5,2) for exact money. This is the cost figure the Sage export consumes.
invoice_lines.thc float NOT NULL (2017_03_30_145155 $table->float('thc')). DESIGN: legacy float → numeric (house convention).
invoice_lines.cbd float NOT NULL (2017_03_30_145155 $table->float('cbd')). DESIGN: legacy float → numeric (house convention).
invoice_lines.pieces smallInteger default 1 (2017_03_30_182402 $table->smallInteger('pieces')->default(1)).

entities.proposal_reason: Real PhytoVerify finance source — invoice line items, the highest-value cost source for the Sage export (PhytoverifyOG 2017_03_07_173118_create_invoice_lines_table.php + thc/cbd/pieces amendments). invoice_id is an in-file FK → invoices (cascade). Bridges finance↔refinement via package_id → packages (05), cross-file so no in-file rel (same convention as finance_activities.product_id). DESIGN: int ids→uuid; unit_cost float(5,2)→numeric(5,2).

source_columns: DESIGN: 'nvidia' is an aspirational/never-emitted value — no server logAiCall path in nexus-intel ever writes provider:'nvidia' (it exists only as a frontend integrations-catalog label). 'anthropic' and 'groq' are the real emitted providers; the value is kept in the CHECK to avoid over-narrowing the fallback chain.

logAiCall source label (server.js routes/ai.js:145 source:'email_draft'; also hub/cache/emerald/photon/ai — all sales/CRM). DESIGN: sop-draft/capa/consumer-copy are aspirational future consumers, not present callers.
logAiCall row stores `email: aiEmail` (server.js:1465); routes/usage.js byUser buckets on e.email (line 57). The AI log has no user uuid — keyed by rep email.
logAiCall promptTokens (server.js:1466)
logAiCall completionTokens (server.js:1466)
logAiCall totalTokens (server.js:1467); routes/usage.js reads e.totalTokens (line 53)
logAiCall costUsd — anthropic callCost (server.js:1467), 0 for groq (1490)/nvidia (1513); every row carries a numeric cost
DESIGN: not persisted per-call; spend cap is two scalar config values (anthropicSpendCap/anthropicSpendUsed in server-config.json, server.js:1444-1446).
DESIGN: per-row flag is a design artifact. stripCustomerPII runs unconditionally for every call (server.js:1378-1397, 1436) but the result is never written to the log row.

entities.proposal_reason: Shared AI service audit (provider fallback + PII strip + spend cap). Real nexus-intel AI features are sales/CRM only (email_draft/hub/cache/emerald/photon/ai). DESIGN: quality (SOP/CAPA) and consumer-profile (copy) are aspirational future consumers, not present callers.

source_columns: DESIGN: global / per-feature / per-user. Real cap is a SINGLE global lifetime scalar (anthropicSpendUsed >= anthropicSpendCap, server.js:1444-1446) — no scope dimension.
DESIGN: real cap is lifetime, not periodic — period is a design synthesis.
DESIGN: cap is provider-specific. Only Anthropic accrues cost (anthropicSpendCap/anthropicSpendUsed, server.js:1444-1446); groq/nvidia log costUsd:0 (server.js:1490,1513) and are uncapped.
DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_CAP=5.00 (server.js:1249)
anthropicSpendUsed (server.js:1445-1446)

business_rules.title: Revenue immutable after close
business_rules.statement: A revenue record is immutable once isClosed=true.

business_rules.title: Accounting stays in Sage (CSV export boundary)
business_rules.statement: Cost/accounting lives in Sage; Nexus only exports an activity CSV — it does not own the ledger.
